name: fylr File Picker
description: Entity Browser widget that copies files and metadata from a fylr (easydb) DAM into Drupal media.
project_description:
This module connects to the fylr digital asset management system: You can select images in fylr or easydb and copy them to your Drupal.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10.3+ or 11 for version 2.1.0 (or Drupal 9 for version 2.0.0) 
 Entity Browser 
 Media module (in Drupal core) 
 
 Back to top 

 Recommended modules 
 
 ctools if you want to edit the entity browsers using a graphic user interface (see the "Configure the Entity Browser" section in the Readme file) 
 Content Translation (in Drupal core) if you want to import multilingual metadata to a multilingual site 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Enable the Media module first and then install the fylr File Picker module. Install the "Entity Browser" and "fylr File Picker" modules as usual. Add some lines to sites/default/services.yml, see the Readme file for a detailed description of the installation and configuration of the module.
